How to harden SSH on a Linux server

Disable password logins and use keys instead. Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config and set PasswordAuthentication no.

Restrict users

Use AllowUsers deploy so that only the deploy account can log in. Forget the old advice about changing the port: it only reduces log noise.
